grandline.fruit.zoan_required: Transform first — this technique needs your Zoan form.
fruit.grandline.pika.desc: Glint-Glint Fruit (Logia): become light. Instant lasers, light-speed travel and kicks, a barrage of light beads and a sword of solid light.
fruit.grandline.magu.desc: Magma-Magma Fruit (Logia): become magma. Beats fire and ice; melts the ground and turns the sea it touches to obsidian.
fruit.grandline.suna.desc: Sand-Sand Fruit (Logia): become sand. Sandstorms, sand blades and a touch that dries anything out. Water is its weakness: wet sand cannot scatter.
fruit.grandline.moku.desc: Smoke-Smoke Fruit (Logia): become smoke. Bind, blind and capture enemies, and fly on a plume of smoke.
fruit.grandline.yami.desc: Dark-Dark Fruit: darkness with infinite gravity. Swallows attacks and people and cancels other Devil Fruits on touch — but its user can never become intangible and takes more damage.
fruit.grandline.gura.desc: Tremor-Tremor Fruit: create earthquakes. Shockwave punches, cracks in the air itself and tsunamis raised from the sea.
fruit.grandline.ito.desc: String-String Fruit: razor strings that cut, puppet bodies, carry you across the sky and close into the Birdcage.
fruit.grandline.hana.desc: Flower-Flower Fruit: sprout copies of your arms, eyes and hands on any surface — even on your enemies.
fruit.grandline.bari.desc: Barrier-Barrier Fruit: the strongest defence. Barrier walls and stairs, a crashing shield, and a ball that absorbs everything until it shatters.
fruit.grandline.tori_phoenix.desc: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Phoenix (Mythical Zoan): blue flames of rebirth heal you while transformed, and wings carry you through the sky.
fruit.grandline.ushi_bison.desc: Ox-Ox Fruit, Model: Bison (Zoan): a heavy, tough body made for charging, goring and trampling.
fruit.grandline.neko_leopard.desc: Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Leopard (Zoan): a fast, deadly hunter — pounces, claws, flying kicks and ambushes.
fruit.grandline.shio.desc: ORIGINAL — Salt-Salt Fruit: create and control salt. Crystal spikes, salt walls and salt flats that crystallise even out of the sea, and a touch that dries bodies out. Fish-Men and other sea-dwellers take 50% more damage from salt.
fruit.grandline.kagami.desc: ORIGINAL — Mirror-Mirror Fruit: make and step through mirrors. Reflect projectiles back at the shooter, step out of a target's reflection, blind with flashes and split light through a prism. Light cannot hurt you.
fruit.grandline.uzu.desc: ORIGINAL — Whirl-Whirl Fruit: spin anything into a vortex. Near water your whirls carry real sea water (reaching even Logia users); at sea the Maelstrom drags enemies and boats under.
fruit.grandline.kane.desc: ORIGINAL — Bell-Bell Fruit: your body rings like a great bell. Every hit leaves enemies ringing; Resonance detonates the ringing straight through any guard.
